question: Show yearly revenue growth percentage by product category
generated_sql:
SELECT 
        DimProductCategory.EnglishProductCategoryName,
        DimDate.CalendarYear,
        SUM(FactInternetSales.SalesAmount) AS CurrentRevenue
    FROM FactInternetSales
    JOIN DimDate ON FactInternetSales.OrderDateKey = DimDate.DateKey
    JOIN DimProduct ON FactInternetSales.ProductKey = DimProduct.ProductKey
    JOIN DimProductSubcategory ON DimProduct.ProductSubcategoryKey = DimProductSubcategory.ProductSubcategoryKey
    JOIN DimProductCategory ON DimProductSubcategory.ProductCategoryKey = DimProductCategory.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY DimProductCategory.EnglishProductCategoryName, DimDate.CalendarYear
)
SELECT 
    EnglishProductCategoryName,
    CalendarYear,
    CurrentRevenue,
    LAG(CurrentRevenue, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY EnglishProductCategoryName ORDER BY CalendarYear) AS PreviousRevenue,
    ROUND(
        ((CurrentRevenue - LAG(CurrentRevenue, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY EnglishProductCategoryName ORDER BY CalendarYear)) 
        / NULLIF(LAG(CurrentRevenue, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY EnglishProductCategoryName ORDER BY CalendarYear), 0)) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS GrowthPercentage
FROM YearlyRevenue
ORDER BY EnglishProductCategoryName, CalendarYear;

question: Show customers whose average order value exceeds the overall average order value
generated_sql:
SELECT 
        DimCustomer.CustomerKey,
        SUM(FactInternetSales.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales,
        COUNT(FactInternetSales.SalesOrderNumber) AS NumOrders
    FROM FactInternetSales
    JOIN DimCustomer ON FactInternetSales.CustomerKey = DimCustomer.CustomerKey
    GROUP BY DimCustomer.CustomerKey
)
SELECT 
    ct.CustomerKey,
    ct.TotalSales,
    ct.NumOrders,
    CAST(ct.TotalSales AS FLOAT) / ct.NumOrders AS AvgOrderValue
FROM CustomerTotals ct
WHERE ct.NumOrders > 0
    AND CAST(ct.TotalSales AS FLOAT) / ct.NumOrders > (
        SELECT 
            CAST(SUM(ct2.TotalSales) AS FLOAT) / SUM(ct2.NumOrders)
        FROM CustomerTotals ct2
        WHERE ct2.NumOrders > 0
    );

FROM dimcustomer ct

        SELECT 
            CAST(SUM(ct2.TotalSales) AS FLOAT) / SUM(ct2.NumOrders)
        FROM dimcustomer ct2
        WHERE ct2.NumOrders > 0
    );

question: Show customers whose revenue contribution exceeds 5 percent of total company revenue
generated_sql:
SELECT 
        CustomerKey,
        SUM(SalesAmount) AS CustomerRevenue
    FROM FactInternetSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
TotalRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(SalesAmount) AS TotalRevenue
    FROM FactInternetSales
)
SELECT 
    c.CustomerKey,
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName,
    cr.CustomerRevenue,
    (cr.CustomerRevenue * 100.0 / tr.TotalRevenue) AS Percentage
FROM CustomerRevenue cr
JOIN DimCustomer c ON cr.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
CROSS JOIN TotalRevenue tr
WHERE cr.CustomerRevenue > 0.05 * tr.TotalRevenue;
repaired_sql:
SELECT 
        CustomerKey,
        SUM(SalesAmount) AS dimcustomer
    FROM FactInternetSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
TotalRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(SalesAmount) AS TotalRevenue
    FROM FactInternetSales
)
SELECT 
    c.CustomerKey,
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName,
    cr.dimcustomer,
    (cr.dimcustomer * 100.0 / tr.TotalRevenue) AS Percentage
FROM dimcustomer cr
JOIN DimCustomer c ON cr.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
CROSS JOIN TotalRevenue tr
WHERE cr.dimcustomer > 0.05 * tr.TotalRevenue;
